root_cause.text: The io_import_umem function in the io_uring zcrx subsystem leaks memory because it fails to free the allocated page pointer array in the error handling path when scatter-gather list initialization fails.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states the previous fix "didn't free the page array," and the patch diff adds `kvfree(pages);` in the error handling block immediately following `unpin_user_pages(pages, nr_pages);`.
